All 44 pytest cases pass. Verified live sheet is read-only during QA; registry.json SHA-1 unchanged after --pull and --diff and --dry-run runs. Offline unit tests for diff_sheet / apply_change_log confirm: Status→PENDING (invalid status→REJECTED), Title/other→REJECTED with 'column not editable in Phase 1', Priority→APPLIED SOURCE=DASHBOARD, Assignee ignored (no CL row, captured into assignees dict), invalid Registered→REJECTED, APPROVED rows applied → APPLIED with Decided-at populated and item status mutated. critical_code_review_comments: sheets_sync.py now 737 lines — still approaching the 700-line split threshold; splitting classify_status + area normaliser + diff/apply into submodules would ease future maintenance.

diff_sheet overloads the Change Log Note column to encode 'fresh dashboard priority' vs 'already applied' via suffix 'done'. A dedicated Decision value (e.g., APPLIED_DASHBOARD / APPLIED_DASHBOARD_DONE) would be clearer than string-suffix sentinels.

prepare_registry mutates registry.items in place during --dry-run (adds _dates_v2 and bumps last_updated in memory). Since cmd_push only persists on non-dry-run, this is safe BUT means two in-process --dry-run calls in the same Python process would diverge; sub-process invocations (as in tests) are fine. Document the in-memory-only guarantee or deep-copy in dry-run mode.

apply_change_log looks at r[7] == 'SOURCE=DASHBOARD' AND `not r[7].endswith('done')` — but r[7]=='SOURCE=DASHBOARD' already can't end with 'done', so the second check only matters after a mutation to 'SOURCE=DASHBOARD; done'. Minor; flag as readability.

'Live blockers (Blocked on)' = 15 but registry has 16 PARKED + 2 DUPLICATE and some INTAKE/PLANNING items with blocked_by. Confirm 15 is correct by expectation (brief §5 drops blockers on closed items).
